A pipeline IS its stages, so those stay first-class; everything else it parents is unbounded.
RelatedRolePolicy is `smart` here precisely because Deals can run to thousands on one pipeline --
this is the flood case the ranker exists for, and the one place in Sales it earns its keep.
A stage is a small record whose children are history (stage events in, deals currently sitting).
Nothing here is edited through the children, so they go to More.
An account has one child that matters and it is the point of the record: its deals. 32 fields is
enough to want accordion grouping, not enough to need left-nav.
THE ONE GENUINELY AMBIGUOUS FORM IN SALES. A contact parents Deals TWICE -- once as primary
contact, once as billing contact -- and both grids would otherwise render titled "Deals", side by
side, with no way to tell which is which. The disambiguation is per-RELATIONSHIP and lives in
metadata/entity-relationships/.form-chrome.json; the layout choice here just gives it room.
The join between a deal and a contact. Opened from either side; parents nothing.
accordion, no related policy needed: there are no children to rank.
